family.description: DgaF is part of the dga operon required for wild-type growth of Salmonella Typhimurium with D-glucosaminate. It catalyses the conversion of keto-3-deoxygluconate 6-phosphate (KDGP) to yield pyruvate and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. Orthologues of the dga genes are largely restricted to certain enteric bacteria and a few species in the phylum Firmicutes [[cite:PUB00075650]].
family.name: KDGP aldolase
